items.title: `ReactiveServer::revoke` (rpc.vl:3165-3190) sends the client NO frame: a revoke from app code leaves the view reading a stale `Ready`, and its later `Subscribe`s are dropped silently
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-03 (lane papers-56's find; A175 depends on it)
items.discussion: lane papers-56 (Order 56), writing rpc-revoke.md: the A175 item's 'the view closes and the mint re-asks' is WRONG today - nothing tells the client; rpc-revoke.md's design sends one `Patch` of `Gone` per slot before revoking the channel, which is this fix
items.body: A revoked channel must tell its client: one `Gone` per slot it held (the client's existing `Gone` handling lands `replica.set(None)` and `states()` reads `Absent`), then the channel is dropped; a later `Subscribe` on it is answered with a refusal frame, not dropped. Pin: a server-side revoke makes the client read `Absent` on the next tick and a re-hold re-asks. Sizing S; built as part of A175 or alone.

items.title: The server never acknowledges a client-released BASE slot (`release_grant`, mirror.vl:669-690, never adds to `acked`), so the client's `retired` readers for bases may never be forgotten
items.kind: bug (std::rpc mirror; a leak on the client)
items.discussion: lane papers-56 (Order 56): read while tracing the grant tables for rpc-revoke.md; the non-base slots are acked and forgotten, the base path is not
items.body: Confirm with a client-side census (the `retired` map's size after N holds and releases of a base); if it grows, `release_grant` acks the base release as it does a slot's. Pin on the mirror differential. Sizing XS-S; the lane that builds A175 is in the file.

items.title: Binding `Bytes` to a `std::db` parameter works on node (`__db_bind` lets a `Uint8Array` through, transformer.rs:1922) but fails rustc natively - `vilan_rt::Any` has no BLOB arm - and BLOB columns are read back as TEXT (vilan-rt-sqlite lib.rs:362-364)
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-03 (lane papers-56's find; sql-value.md's `Bytes` impl needs it)
items.discussion: lane papers-56 (Order 56): sql-value.md implements `SqlValue` for `Bytes` (BLOB), which is only honest once the native binder and the column reader carry a BLOB arm
items.body: Add the BLOB arm to `vilan_rt::Any` and the sqlite binder; read BLOB columns back as `Bytes`; pin on the native differential (a round trip of a byte string with a NUL and a high byte). Sizing S; rides with M175 or before it.

items.title: A `Subscribe` naming an UNKNOWN base drops the rest of its frame (mirror.vl:566-571): one bad base silently loses every other subscription written in the same frame
items.discussion: lane papers-56 (Order 56): this is why rpc-revoke.md defers per-grant revocation (it needs a tombstone grant so a late `Subscribe` on it is answered, not dropped)
items.body: Answer the unknown base with a refusal for THAT entry and keep reading the frame; pin with a two-subscription frame whose first base is unknown (the second must land). Sizing XS-S.
